A '''school''' was established on the [[planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. It was painted rust red and built with [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] besides a river. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it was already abandoned and used by the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] refugees, and lovers, [[Halle Dray]] and [[Kiro Chen]] as their secret hiding place.<ref name="hostage" />

When the [[Alderaanian faction|faction]] that Dray and Chen belonged to kidnapped [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during her visit to Delaya, they kept her prisoner in the school and used it as the rendezvous point for their meeting with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] representative to hand over Organa in exchange for a new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to settle on.<ref name="hostage" />
